card.name: Linking words before tamoxifen or comparator drug
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, for, with, receiving, or, plus, a comma) that come right before the name of a comparator breast-cancer drug, mostly tamoxifen. Seen in trial comparisons of letrozole, anastrozole or exemestane against another drug.

modes.label: Comparison with the other arm
modes.description: A linking word after a percentage or group, just before the comparator drug is named.
modes.example: hypercholesterolemia was reported in 52.3% of letrozole patients and 28.6%<< of>> tamoxifen patients.

modes.label: Lists and interactions
modes.description: A word or comma in a list of hormone drugs or a drug-interaction note, right before the next drug.
modes.example: Refer to the Full Prescribing Information for the coadministered fulvestrant, tamoxifen<<,>> imlunestrant or aromat
